summary: Checked that the 4 questionnaire selects (Estado civil, Tipo de ensino médio, UF ensino médio, Ano ensino médio) are gone, using Playwright on desktop and mobile plus the admin API. inscricao.html: none of the 4 names are in the DOM, there is no fieldset.vn-quest, and the page has no 'estado civil' or 'ensino médio' text. The mobile layout at 390px is fine: no horizontal overflow and no empty fieldsets. The Continuar button enables once only the remaining required fields are filled. Full flow inscricao -> dados-inscricao (cargo 1 Delegado R$ 200,00) -> confirmacao -> inscricao-realizada -> pagamento-pix works, and the PIX page shows R$ 200,00 with the correct name and CPF. confirmacao.html has 5 sections (Dados da inscrição, Dados pessoais, Endereço, Contato, Documento de identificação) with 19 rows, all filled, 0 empty or dash rows, and no Estado civil or Ensino médio rows. In the admin /donaspainel Cadastro tab, the detail modal shows none of the 4 fields. Stored form_data has none of the 4 keys, and the export-full.txt export has no such labels. Test records were deleted afterwards.

minor.issue: Uses delete_one, so when the same CPF has duplicate cadastros docs, only one is removed per call. Leftover CPF 45645371801 from an earlier iteration needed 2 calls to clear. Probably should be delete_many.

ui_bugs.issue: Shows 'Nenhum documento de identificação anexado' even when docs were uploaded. The backend stores form_data.doc_frente/doc_verso, but the modal reads docArquivoData/docArquivoVersoData. This was already broken before this change.

action_items: Optional: map doc_frente/doc_verso into renderDocCard in admin-extras.js so the detail modal shows the uploaded ID images
critical_code_review_comments: confirmacao.html section testids skip conf-sec-2 (0,1,3,4,5), a leftover from the removed Ensino médio section. Cosmetic only.
confirmacao.html still calls set('c-uf-prova') etc. for the existing rows. No orphan set() calls for the removed fields, so this is fine.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_REMOCAO QUEST (CPF 529.982.247-25), then deleted its inscription and cadastro. Also removed the leftover TEST CANDIDATO PCAP cadastro (CPF 456.453.718-01, 2 docs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each browser_automation call starts with fresh localStorage, so run inscricao -> confirmacao in ONE script. The CEP lookup is async and overwrites the address fields: type the CEP first (01310100 works), wait about 5s, then fill the other fields. dados-inscricao needs VAGA + MUNICIPIO_PROVA + the input[name=termo] checkbox. After confirmar, the flow goes to /inscricao-realizada.html, and its 'Pagar inscrição' button leads to /pagamento-pix.html. Admin row actions: [data-testid=btn-exibir-cadastro] opens [data-testid=modal-detalhes-cadastro].
